## Tool - che

### Description - che

`che` as a brew formula: `Formula/che.rb` tracks the latest release, and one `Formula/che@<version>.rb` per published version lets you pin.

Every formula here is committed by che's release job, never by hand.

### Purpose - che

che's other channels sit behind GitLab. This tap is the anonymous one: brew users install and pin che with no GitLab credential.

### Basic Usage - che

#### Installation - che

The tap lives on GitLab, so give `brew tap` the repository URL:

```sh
$ brew tap konradodwrot/che https://gitlab.com/konradodwrot/che/che-homebrew-tap.git
$ brew install che
```

Pin a version through its versioned formula:

```sh
$ brew install che@0.0.152
```

#### Usage - che

Once tapped, `che` upgrades with the rest of your formulae:

```sh
$ brew upgrade che
```

`Formula/che.rb` tracks the latest release; each `Formula/che@<version>.rb` stays pinned to the version it names, so an older one remains installable after newer releases land.

Nothing here is edited by hand: che's release job commits every formula through the GitLab commits API.
